chunks: Aḥmad ibn ʿAbdūn narrated to me, from ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad ibn al-Zubayr, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥasan ibn Faḍḍāl, from Muḥammad and Aḥmad, the two sons of al-Ḥasan, from their father, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Bukayr, who said:

Regarding the young girl when she menstruates for the first time: blood continues upon her, so she is deemed a mustaḥāḍah. She waits concerning salat (prayer), so she does not pray until the maximum period of menstruation has passed. When that has passed—and it is ten days—she does what the mustaḥāḍah does, then she performs salat (prayer), and she continues praying for the remainder of her month.

Then, in the second occurrence, she leaves salat (prayer) for the minimum period that a woman leaves salat (prayer), and she sits out the minimum duration of menses, which is three days. If menstruation continues upon her, she performs salat (prayer) at the time of the salat (prayer) she had been performing, and she makes the time of her purity the maximum possible duration of purity, while making her leaving of salat (prayer) the minimum possible duration of menstruation.

What is contained in the long report of Yūnus that we cited in our larger book does not contradict these two reports: namely, that one in this condition leaves salat (prayer) for seven days in the month and performs salat (prayer) for the rest of the month. That may be understood as referring to what affects each one of two months when two months are considered together, because if she leaves salat (prayer) in the first month for ten days and in the second for three days, half of that is approximately seven days. Thus it accords with what the narration of ʿAbd Allāh ibn Bukayr contains, and it accords with all the principles.

key_terms.الْجَارِيَةِ: a young girl, here referring to one beginning menstruation
key_terms.طُهْرِهَا: her state or period of purity
key_terms.مُسْتَحَاضَةً: a woman experiencing istiḥāḍah, non-menstrual irregular bleeding

ai.seo_question: How does a girl who menstruates for the first time and continues bleeding determine when to stop and resume salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This report gives a legal ruling for a young girl who sees blood for the first time and whose bleeding continues, distinguishing between menstruation and istiḥāḍah. It explains how long she should leave salat (prayer) initially, how she acts in the following occurrence, and how apparently differing reports may be reconciled through calculation across two months.
